h: פָּרָשַׁת כִּי תָבוֹא, י״א Ki Savo, 11
The Hidden Light of Oral Torah Restores the Covenant

p: that the seven haftaros of consolation
הוּא כְּנֶגֶד מִדַּת צַדִּיק יְסוֹד עוֹלָם
corresponds to the attribute of "the tzaddik, foundation of the world."
דִּכְתִיב אוֹר זָרוּעַ לַצַּדִּיק (תְּהִלִּים צז, יא)
as it is written, 'Light is sown for the tzaddik'" (Tehillim 97:11).
וּכְמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בַּזֹּהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק ב קמט, א)
and as written in the holy Zohar (Zohar II 149a):
and produces offspring and seeds and fruits,
and from it the world is sustained, etc.;
is called "the tzaddik, foundation of the world,"
וְאִם הָיָה נִגְנַז הָאוֹר מִכֹּל וָכֹל
and if the light had been hidden entirely,
the world would not be sustained;
but one thread of this light
and from it the world is sustained.
קוּמִי אוֹרִי כִּי בָא אוֹרֵךְ (יְשַׁעְיָה ס, א)
"Arise, shine, for your light has come" (Yeshayahu 60:1);
and it is brought in the Pesikta (the new one):
and your light is My light."
And this is based on what they said
that the primordial light was hidden away
for those who toil in the Oral Torah;
is the aspect of the primordial light,
"My word shall distill like the dew" (Devarim 32:2),
which is the dew of Atika
for the Oral Torah was handed to Yisrael;
מַאי עָבִיד קוּדְשָׁא בְּרִיךְ הוּא וְכוּלֵּי
What did the Holy One, blessed be He, do, etc.?
'My children have triumphed over Me,' etc."
"They were disputing in the Heavenly Academy, etc.
And the main power of the Oral Torah
וְהָיָה הוּא יִהְיֶה לְּךָ לְפֶה (שְׁמוֹת ד, טז)
"And he shall be to you for a mouth" (Shemos 4:16),
and it is written, "For the lips of the Kohen
and they shall seek Torah from his mouth" (Malachi 2:7).
And this is why there was given to him
the mitzvah of lighting the Menorah,
whose matter is "Come and give light to me,"
And this is the meaning of
that it is called by your name.
is the words of the living God,
דְּבָרַי אֲשֶׁר שַׂמְתִּי בְּפִיךָ (יְשַׁעְיָה נט, כא)
"My words that I have placed in your mouth" (Yeshayahu 59:21);
as is said in the parable
of the sighted man and the blind man,
to whom he said, "Come and give light to me."
And this is "your light is My light."
"And the glory of Hashem has shone upon you, etc.,
וּכְבוֹדוֹ עָלַיִךְ יֵרָאֶה וְגוֹמֵר (שָׁם ס, א–ב)
and His glory shall be seen upon you, etc." (ibid. 60:1–2);
and what is meant is the Beis HaMikdash,
"From the place of the Beis HaMikdash,
from there light goes forth to the world;
'And behold, the glory of Hashem, etc.,
and the earth shone with His glory' (Yechezkel 43:2);
and 'His glory' means only the Beis HaMikdash,
'A throne of glory, exalted from the beginning,
is the place of our Sanctuary'" (Yirmiyahu 17:12).
And as we find regarding the Mishkan,
where it is written, "And the glory of Hashem
the place of the root of the Oral Torah,
כִּי מִצִּיּוֹן תֵּצֵא תוֹרָה (יְשַׁעְיָה ב, ג)
"For from Tziyon shall go forth Torah" (Yeshayahu 2:3);
that in the Chamber of Hewn Stone,
from it Torah goes forth to all Yisrael;
from which instruction went forth to Yisrael."
And the attribute of "tzaddik, foundation of the world"
is called "for all that is in heaven and on earth,"
which is the sixth in the pasuk,
לְךָ ה׳ הַגְּדוּלָּה וְגוֹמֵר (דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים א כט, יא)
"Yours, Hashem, is the greatness, etc." (Divrei HaYamim I 29:11);
and we render it in Targum,
"which holds fast to heaven and earth"
שֶׁהוּא הַמְחַבֵּר אוֹר תּוֹרָה שֶׁבְּעַל פֶּה
for it is what joins the light of the Oral Torah:
which receives from the light of the Written Torah,
וּכְמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בַּזֹּהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק ב קסו, ב)
and as written in the holy Zohar (Zohar II 166b):
the Holy One, blessed be He, sowed
in the garden of His delights,
and made it into rows upon rows
who is the gardener of the garden, etc."

p: "'For all that is in heaven and on earth'
this is the war of Sisera,
as it says, 'From heaven they fought,
And this needs to be understood:
why is the war of Sisera alluded to here
of the thirty-one kings and the like?
אַךְ לָמָּה בֶּאֱמֶת כְּתִיב בְּמִלְחָמָה זוֹ
But why indeed is it written of this war,
and why did Hashem, may He be blessed, need
With the breath of His mouth
He can slay a thousand like them!
שֶׁאֵין הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא נִפְרָע מִן הָאוּמָּה
that the Holy One, blessed be He, does not exact retribution from a nation
until the time of its being sent away,
"In full measure, when You send it away, etc." (Yeshayahu 27:8);
"For the iniquity of the Emori is not yet complete
And the matter is that in every nation
there is a spark of holiness
וְאַתָּה מְחַיֶּה אֶת כּוּלָּם (נְחֶמְיָה ט, ו)
"And You give life to them all" (Nechemiah 9:6);
and this must be extracted from them;
and when they extract from there
then they perish from the world.
and in Sefer HaMafte'ach of Rabbeinu Nissim
and who are they? Rabbi Akiva."
it is brought that Rabbi Akiva came from Sisera,
the wife of Chever the Keini.
And it is brought from the holy Arizal
the root of the Written Torah,
the root of the Oral Torah.
And for this reason Rabbi Akiva came
from Sisera and from the wife of Chever the Keini,
sparks of the aspect of the Oral Torah;
And the Keinim, it is brought (Mechilta Yisro),
went up from the City of Palms,
in the days of mourning for Moshe;
because he counseled and spread Torah in Yisrael,
and the Keinim went to him,
from the root of the Oral Torah;
And Yericho is called the City of Palms,
וּכְתִיב צַדִּיק כַּתָּמָר יִפְרָח (תְּהִלִּים צב, יג)
and it is written, "The righteous shall flourish like the palm" (Tehillim 92:13);
for they were in the aspect of the attribute of tzaddik.
And so too Bavel is a place of palms,
"The Holy One, blessed be He, exiled
only so that they would eat dates
and occupy themselves with Torah, etc."
And for this reason it is brought
"And what is Bavel doing here, etc.?
the main spread of the Oral Torah.
And this is alluded to in the pasuk,
"And it shall be, if you go with us,
which Hashem will do for us,
we will do good to you" (Bamidbar 10:32);
וְתוֹרָה שֶׁבְּעַל פֶּה גַּם כֵּן נִקְרָא טוֹב
And the Oral Torah too is called "good,"
דִּכְתִיב טוֹב לִי תּוֹרַת פִּיךָ (תְּהִלִּים קיט, עב)
as it is written, "The Torah of Your mouth is good for me" (Tehillim 119:72).
And this is why it says
that they gave him the fat of Yericho:
הַיְינוּ בְּחִינַת קְדוּשַּׁת תּוֹרָה שֶׁבְּעַל פֶּה
that is, the aspect of the holiness of the Oral Torah.
וּמִשּׁוּם זֶה יָצָא נֶפֶשׁ רַבִּי עֲקִיבָא
And because of this the soul of Rabbi Akiva came forth
from the wife of Chever the Keini,
the root of the Oral Torah,
the spark of holiness of the Oral Torah.
the aspect of the attribute of "tzaddik, foundation of the world";
וּמֵהַאי טַעְמָא אָמְרוּ (בָּבָא בַּתְרָא יב, א)
and for this reason they said (Bava Basra 12a)
מִשְּׁמֵיהּ דְּרַבִּי עֲקִיבָא בֶּן יוֹסֵף כְּוָתֵיהּ
in the name of Rabbi Akiva ben Yosef in accordance with him,"
where he is mentioned by his father's name;
whereas throughout the Shas he is mentioned by his own name alone,
and not by his father's name.
of Rabbi Akiva bar Yosef in accordance with him,"
that for this reason he is called ben Yosef,
since he was the root of the attribute of Yosef HaTzaddik;
and for this reason he is
the aspect of the root of the Oral Torah.
this was because "someone born under his star was with him";
so perforce it was intended by ruach hakodesh.
also in this manner of speech:
"There is one man who is destined to be, etc.,
and Akiva ben Yosef is his name,
heaps upon heaps of halachos, etc.";
הוּזְכַּר שָׁם גַּם כֵּן בְּשֵׁם אָבִיו

p: And this is the matter of the war of Sisera:
because there was contained in him,
who was the root of the Oral Torah;
and this was the matter of the war with him.
And this is what they expounded in the Gemara
"'For all that is in heaven and on earth'
this is the war of Sisera";
to extract from him the spark of holiness,
the soul of Rabbi Akiva ben Yosef,
who was the root of the Oral Torah,
and a son of the attribute of Yosef HaTzaddik,
And this they extracted from him
עַל יְדֵי יָעֵל אֵשֶׁת חֶבֶר הַקֵּינִי
through Yael, the wife of Chever the Keini,
from the root of the Oral Torah,
And this is what they said (Yevamos 103b):
That he cast filth into her";
and through this she extracted from him
the holiness that was found in him,
which is the soul of Rabbi Akiva,
which was the attribute of "tzaddik, foundation of the world,"
And the connection of this haftarah to this parshah:
for it is brought in Likkutei Torah
from the holy Arizal, of blessed memory,
that the curses in Mishneh Torah
are to rectify the blemish of the covenant;
and this consolation is the sixth,
שֶׁהוּא כְּנֶגֶד מִדַּת צַדִּיק יְסוֹד עוֹלָם
which corresponds to the attribute of "tzaddik, foundation of the world."
and it says in the Pesikta:
"In Your light we shall see light (Tehillim 36:10)
this is the light of Mashiach, etc."
אָמַר לֵיהּ מִילַּט קָא לָיְיטַתְּ לִי
He said to him, 'Are you cursing me?'
He said to him, 'It is a verse that is written:
For behold, darkness shall cover the earth,
but upon you Hashem will shine,
and His glory shall be seen upon you'" (Yeshayahu 60:2).
that are found among the nations,
thereby they will extract from them all life;
and then "upon you Hashem will shine"
that is, the light of Mashiach
"and His glory shall be seen upon you,"
they divide Nitzavim and Vayelech into two,
but they do not divide Matos and Masei;
in order to read on one Shabbos
a parshah that does not speak of curses.
that the matter of the seven consolations
that there is no accusation at all against Yisrael,
since they did not blemish any attribute
And since they are clarified in the sixth attribute,
which is "tzaddik, foundation of the world,"
accordingly, when the next Shabbos comes,
corresponds to the attribute of Malchus,
"let the year begin with its blessings,"
And for this reason they divide,
which corresponds to the attribute of tzaddik;
שֶׁיִּשְׂרָאֵל מְבוֹרָרִים בְּמִדָּה זוֹ גַּם כֵּן
that Yisrael are clarified in this attribute too.
which corresponds to the attribute of Malchus,
it will be "let the year begin with its blessings."
